project_type: pnpm monorepo — Next.js 14 web app + Discord bot (Sapphire) + BullMQ worker + shared packages
build_system: pnpm workspaces. Root scripts: 'pnpm --recursive build', 'pnpm --filter web build', 'pnpm --filter @esports/game-rules build'. Packages compile with 'tsc' to dist/. tsconfig.base.json sets module:commonjs, target:ES2022, strict:true, outDir:./dist.
test_framework: No test runner configured. Verification is via 'pnpm --filter <pkg> type-check' (tsc --noEmit) and 'pnpm --filter <pkg> build' (tsc to dist). These are the ONLY verification commands — there are no jest/vitest tests to run.
build_command: pnpm --filter @esports/game-rules build && pnpm --filter @esports/scoring build && pnpm --filter @esports/tournament-engine build && pnpm --filter web type-check
test_command: pnpm --filter @esports/tournament-engine type-check && pnpm --filter @esports/game-rules type-check && pnpm --filter @esports/scoring type-check && pnpm --filter web type-check
verification_instructions: For each package: run 'pnpm --filter <pkg-name> type-check'. For packages that emit dist/, run 'pnpm --filter <pkg-name> build'. For the web app: run 'pnpm --filter web type-check'. Confirm exit code 0. No runtime/DB tests needed for the plan step.
snapshot_or_generated_files: packages/database/src/generated/client — generated by 'pnpm db:generate'. Never edit generated files. The prisma schema is at packages/database/prisma/schema.prisma and must NOT be modified in Phase 3.
environment_constraints: Windows host (PowerShell shell). Workspace root is D:\Discord Projects\Tournament-Bot\esports-platform. All new files must be created inside this workspace root. NEVER modify D:\Discord Projects\Tournament-Bot\PLAN.md.
contribution_requirements: 1. All DB queries must include guildId scope. 2. Never expose room_credentials, PENDING registrations, or PENDING_REVIEW submissions from public routes. 3. Use camelCase Prisma field names (teamCapacity, registrationOpenAt, guildId). 4. State machine transitions enforced at API level via assertTournamentTransition/assertMatchTransition. 5. Scoring engines (game-rules package) are pure functions — zero Prisma calls inside them. 6. Prisma Decimal to Number conversion only at the edge (in route handlers/serializers). 7. Do NOT modify PLAN.md.
key_patterns: API routes: admin routes use withPermission(AppRole.TOURNAMENT_MANAGER|REFEREE, handler) from @esports/permissions. Public routes use prisma + createClient() from @/lib/supabase/server. Handler context provides { userId, guildId, role, isOwner, params }. All state mutations use prisma.$transaction. OutboxEvent rows are appended inside transactions. AuditLog rows are written for approvals/rejections. Pages: server component fetches data, serializes Date fields to ISO strings, passes to 'use client' child component. Admin pages live under apps/web/src/app/servers/[guildId]/admin/. UI: GlassCard, GlowButton, Badge from @/components/ui/. @tanstack/react-table for data tables. framer-motion for animations. @radix-ui/react-dialog for modals. @radix-ui/react-tabs for tabbed views. sonner for toasts. lucide-react for icons.
directory_structure: apps/web/src/app/api/servers/[guildId]/ — API routes (public and admin). apps/web/src/app/servers/[guildId]/ — Next.js pages. apps/web/src/components/ — React components (admin/, tournament/, ui/). packages/database/ — Prisma client + schema. packages/game-rules/ — pure scoring engine. packages/scoring/ — DB-aware standings computer. packages/tournament-engine/ — state machine. packages/shared-types/ — Zod schemas shared across packages. packages/permissions/ — withPermission HOC + role resolver. .agents/tasks/ — planning artifacts (never committed to git as source code).
